a.lede: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia's office as CEO today to a crowd of applauding employees who stood and filmed the cofounder's first moments back. "Thank you all for the second chances. I'm gonna be a better CEO the second time around," Huang said, as shown in a video of his return. Huang resigned as CEO […]
a.title: Jensen Huang says he’ll be a ‘better CEO’ as staff applauds his return

b.lede: Denny's, the diner where Jensen Huang came up with the idea for Nvidia, has posted a 200-word statement to X in which it expressed its delight at his return to Nvidia after he initially resigned and admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
b.title: Denny’s touts renewed support for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang following reinstatement
